description: A conditional whose predicate is a null bool is an error
notes: The spec's conditional operator requires a bool predicate and only says what true and false select; it doesn't say whether a null bool is an error. hashicorp/hcl reports "Null condition" (ConditionalExpr.Value in hclsyntax/expression.go). A typed null avoids the question of whether the null keyword, a value of the dynamic pseudo-type, makes the result unknown.
